```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(quantreg)
set.seed(42)

n<-100
x <- (1:n)/10

e1 <- 1+2*x+(1/2+x)*rnorm(n)
e2 <- 5 * (rexp(n, 1) - log(2))
e3 <- rt(n, 2)

y1 <- 1+2*x + e1
y2 <- 1+2*x + e2
y3 <- 1+2*x + e3

plot(x,y1)
```


```{r}
lm(y1 ~ x)
lm(y2 ~ x)
lm(y3 ~ x)


```
